course.title: 3-Month Certificate in Computer Applications
course.description: A practical 72-day computer course covering Windows, MS Word, MS Excel, Google Chrome, Email and Internet Safety.

days.title: Introduction to Computer
days.learningOutcome: Student computer ke basic parts identify aur computer ko properly operate kar sake.
practical: Monitor, CPU, Keyboard aur Mouse identify karna
teacherGuide: Computer ke basic parts explain karein
Windows Desktop ke main areas explain karein
Proper shutdown ka method demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Computer ko ON karein, Desktop observe karein aur teacher ki guidance ke mutabiq proper shutdown karein.
days.homework: Computer ke 5 basic parts ke naam yaad karein.

days.title: Mouse and Keyboard
days.learningOutcome: Student mouse aur keyboard ke basic controls confidently use kar sake.
practical: Keyboard par simple sentence type karna
Enter, Space, Backspace aur Delete use karna
Shift, Ctrl aur Alt keys identify karna
teacherGuide: Keyboard ki important keys explain karein
days.studentTask: Mouse aur keyboard use karke 5 lines type karein aur basic editing keys use karein.
days.homework: Keyboard ki 10 important keys ke naam aur functions revise karein.

days.title: Windows Desktop
days.learningOutcome: Student Windows Desktop aur windows management ke basic functions perform kar sake.
teacherGuide: Windows Desktop ka layout explain karein
Start Menu aur Search demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: 3 different programs open karein aur unko minimize, maximize, restore aur close karein.
days.homework: Start Menu aur Taskbar ke functions revise karein.

days.title: Windows Accessories
days.learningOutcome: Student basic Windows accessories open, use aur save kar sake.
teacherGuide: WordPad ka basic interface explain karein
Calculator ke basic operations demonstrate karein
Paint mein simple drawing demonstrate karein
Files save karne ka method explain karein
days.studentTask: WordPad mein 5 lines type karein aur Paint mein simple drawing bana kar save karein.
days.homework: WordPad, Calculator aur Paint ke uses likhein.

days.title: Desktop Customization
days.learningOutcome: Student basic Windows personalization settings change kar sake.
teacherGuide: Date and time settings demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Desktop ko basic level par customize karein aur required settings check karein.
days.homework: Windows personalization ke 5 options ke naam likhein.

days.title: Week 1 Practical Test
days.learningOutcome: Student Week 1 ke computer aur Windows basics independently perform kare.
teacherGuide: Students ko independent practical task dein
Har student ka performance check karein
days.studentTask: Complete Week 1 practical independently perform karein.
days.homework: Week 1 ke tamam topics revise karein.

days.title: This PC and Drives
days.learningOutcome: Student This PC, drives aur folders browse kar sake.
teacherGuide: This PC ka purpose explain karein
Drive aur folder ka difference explain karein
days.studentTask: This PC open karke available drives aur folders explore karein.
days.homework: Drive, folder aur file ki definitions revise karein.

days.title: Creating and Managing Folders
days.learningOutcome: Student folders create, rename, move aur delete kar sake.
teacherGuide: Rename, move aur delete demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Computer Course folder create karke us mein 5 subfolders banayein.
days.homework: Folder management ke keyboard shortcuts revise karein.

days.title: File Management
days.learningOutcome: Student files ko create, rename, copy, paste aur move kar sake.
teacherGuide: File aur folder ka difference explain karein
Copy aur move ka difference demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: 5 files create karke unko rename, copy aur move karein.
days.homework: Copy aur Move ka difference revise karein.

days.title: Copy, Cut and Drag
days.learningOutcome: Student keyboard shortcuts aur drag-and-drop se files manage kar sake.
practical: Drag and drop se files move karna
teacherGuide: Copy, paste aur cut shortcuts demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Different folders ke darmiyan files copy aur move karein.
days.homework: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V aur Ctrl+X yaad karein.

days.title: Recycle Bin
days.learningOutcome: Student deleted files ko restore aur permanently delete kar sake.
teacherGuide: Recycle Bin ka purpose explain karein
Restore aur permanent delete demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Test files delete karke restore karein aur phir permanently remove karein.
days.homework: Recycle Bin ke functions revise karein.

days.title: File Management Test and Project
days.learningOutcome: Student organized folder structure bana kar complete file management perform kare.
teacherGuide: Student ki file organization check karein
days.studentTask: Computer Course naam ka complete folder structure prepare karein.
days.homework: Week 2 revise karein.

days.title: MS Word Introduction
days.learningOutcome: Student MS Word open karke basic interface identify kar sake.
days.studentTask: MS Word open karke interface ke main parts identify karein.
days.homework: MS Word interface ke 6 parts revise karein.

days.title: Creating and Saving Documents
days.learningOutcome: Student Word document create, save, Save As aur open kar sake.
teacherGuide: Save aur Save As ka difference explain karein
days.studentTask: Apne naam se Word document create karke Computer Course folder mein save karein.
days.homework: Save aur Save As ka difference revise karein.

days.title: Selection and Editing
days.learningOutcome: Student Word mein text select aur edit kar sake.
teacherGuide: Copy, cut aur paste demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: 10-line document mein text selection aur editing exercises perform karein.
days.homework: Select All aur editing shortcuts revise karein.

days.title: Clipboard and Drag and Drop
days.learningOutcome: Student clipboard aur drag-and-drop editing techniques use kar sake.
days.studentTask: Document ke paragraphs ko copy, duplicate aur move karein.
days.homework: Clipboard related shortcuts revise karein.

days.title: Find and Replace
days.learningOutcome: Student Word mein words aur phrases find aur replace kar sake.
days.studentTask: Document mein repeated word find karke replace karein.
days.homework: Find and Replace shortcut revise karein.

days.title: Undo, Redo and Basic Word Test
days.learningOutcome: Student basic Word editing workflow independently perform kare.
days.studentTask: Teacher ke diye gaye Word editing test ko independently complete karein.
days.homework: Week 3 revise karein.

days.title: Font Formatting
days.learningOutcome: Student professional text formatting perform kar sake.
days.studentTask: 10-line document ko different font formatting ke sath format karein.
days.homework: Font formatting tools revise karein.

days.title: Advanced Text Formatting
days.learningOutcome: Student advanced text formatting tools use kar sake.
days.studentTask: Science-related text ko advanced formatting ke sath prepare karein.
days.homework: Superscript, Subscript aur Format Painter revise karein.

days.title: Text Alignment
days.learningOutcome: Student text aur headings ko correctly align kar sake.
days.studentTask: Ek professional notice prepare karein jisme different alignments use hon.
days.homework: Four alignment types revise karein.

days.title: Paragraph Formatting
days.learningOutcome: Student paragraph spacing aur indentation control kar sake.
days.studentTask: Three paragraphs ko different spacing aur indentation ke sath format karein.
days.homework: First-line aur hanging indent revise karein.

days.title: Bullets and Numbering
days.learningOutcome: Student lists ko bullets aur numbering ke sath professionally format kar sake.
days.studentTask: Academy rules ki professional bulleted aur numbered list banayein.
days.homework: Bullets aur numbering revise karein.

days.title: Professional Formatting Project
days.learningOutcome: Student professional academy notice create aur format kar sake.
days.studentTask: Mustafa Digital Academy ke liye professional notice create karein.
days.homework: Week 4 revise karein.

days.title: MS Word Tables
days.learningOutcome: Student Word mein table create aur data enter kar sake.
teacherGuide: Rows, columns aur cells explain karein
days.studentTask: 5 columns aur 6 rows ka student table banayein.
days.homework: Table ke basic components revise karein.

days.title: Table Editing
days.learningOutcome: Student table mein rows aur columns add, delete, merge aur split kar sake.
days.studentTask: Existing student table ko edit karke rows/columns add aur remove karein.
days.homework: Merge aur Split Cells revise karein.

days.title: Table Formatting
days.learningOutcome: Student tables ko professional style mein format kar sake.
days.studentTask: Student table ko professional result-sheet style mein format karein.
days.homework: Table formatting options revise karein.

days.title: Page Setup
days.learningOutcome: Student document page settings correctly configure kar sake.
days.studentTask: Ek document ko portrait aur landscape dono formats mein prepare karein.
days.homework: Margins aur orientation revise karein.

days.title: Header, Footer and Page Number
days.learningOutcome: Student documents mein header, footer aur page numbers add kar sake.
days.studentTask: 3-page document mein header, footer aur page numbers add karein.
days.homework: Header, Footer aur Page Number revise karein.

days.title: Result Sheet Project
days.learningOutcome: Student Word mein professional result sheet create kar sake.
days.studentTask: Professional student result sheet create karein.
days.homework: Week 5 revise karein.

days.title: Spelling and Grammar
days.learningOutcome: Student Word ke spelling aur grammar checking tools use kar sake.
teacherGuide: Spelling and Grammar tools demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Mistakes wala paragraph correct karein.
days.homework: Spelling and Grammar tools revise karein.

days.title: Thesaurus and Word Count
days.learningOutcome: Student synonyms aur document statistics check kar sake.
teacherGuide: Thesaurus aur Word Count demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Paragraph mein 5 words ke synonyms find karein aur word count note karein.
days.homework: Thesaurus aur Word Count revise karein.

days.title: Columns
days.learningOutcome: Student document ko multiple columns mein format kar sake.
days.studentTask: Short article ko two-column aur three-column formats mein prepare karein.
days.homework: Columns ke uses revise karein.

days.title: Printing and Print Preview
days.learningOutcome: Student print settings aur print preview correctly use kar sake.
practical: Selected pages print option observe karna
teacherGuide: Page range aur copies explain karein
days.studentTask: Document ka print preview prepare karein aur correct settings select karein.
days.homework: Print Preview ke options revise karein.

days.title: CV and Resume Project
days.learningOutcome: Student basic professional CV/Resume create kar sake.
teacherGuide: Simple professional CV structure demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Apna basic professional CV Word mein create karein.
days.homework: CV ke main sections revise karein.

days.title: MS Word Practical Test
days.learningOutcome: Student Word ke major practical skills independently demonstrate kare.
teacherGuide: Complete Word practical test conduct karein
days.studentTask: Complete Word practical test independently perform karein.
days.homework: Week 3-6 ke Word topics revise karein.

days.title: MS Excel Introduction
days.learningOutcome: Student Excel workbook aur worksheet ke basic components identify kar sake.
teacherGuide: Row, column aur cell relationship demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Excel worksheet mein 10 different cell addresses identify karein.
days.homework: Workbook, worksheet, row, column aur cell revise karein.

days.title: Excel Data Entry
days.learningOutcome: Student Excel cells mein different types ka data enter aur edit kar sake.
practical: Multiple cells mein data enter karna
days.studentTask: Student information ka basic data sheet prepare karein.
days.homework: Excel data types revise karein.

days.title: Rows and Columns
days.learningOutcome: Student rows aur columns insert, delete aur resize kar sake.
teacherGuide: Row aur column management demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Existing data sheet mein rows aur columns add/remove karein.
days.homework: Rows aur columns shortcuts revise karein.

days.title: Excel Worksheets
days.learningOutcome: Student worksheets add, rename, delete, move aur copy kar sake.
days.studentTask: Students, Marks aur Attendance naam se 3 worksheets create karein.
days.homework: Worksheet management revise karein.

days.title: Excel Cell Formatting
days.learningOutcome: Student Excel cells ko professional formatting ke sath prepare kar sake.
days.studentTask: Student data sheet ko professional formatting dein.
days.homework: Excel formatting tools revise karein.

days.title: Excel Basic Test
days.learningOutcome: Student basic Excel data sheet independently create kar sake.
teacherGuide: Basic Excel practical test conduct karein
days.studentTask: Complete student data sheet independently prepare karein.
days.homework: Week 7 revise karein.

days.title: Basic Excel Formulas
days.learningOutcome: Student basic mathematical formulas Excel mein use kar sake.
days.studentTask: 10 rows par basic mathematical calculations perform karein.
days.homework: Basic formulas revise karein.

days.title: SUM Function
days.learningOutcome: Student SUM function se totals calculate kar sake.
days.studentTask: Student marks aur expenses ka total calculate karein.
days.homework: SUM aur AutoSum revise karein.

days.title: AVERAGE Function
days.learningOutcome: Student AVERAGE function se average values calculate kar sake.
teacherGuide: AVERAGE function explain aur demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Students ke marks ka average calculate karein.
days.homework: AVERAGE formula revise karein.

days.title: MIN, MAX and COUNT
days.learningOutcome: Student MIN, MAX aur COUNT functions use kar sake.
teacherGuide: MIN, MAX aur COUNT ka purpose explain karein
days.studentTask: Marks dataset mein minimum, maximum aur count calculate karein.
days.homework: MIN, MAX aur COUNT revise karein.

days.title: Excel Number Formatting
days.learningOutcome: Student numbers, percentages, currency aur dates ko correctly format kar sake.
days.studentTask: Mixed data sheet ko appropriate number formats dein.
days.homework: Percentage, Currency aur Date formatting revise karein.

days.title: Excel Marksheet Project
days.learningOutcome: Student formulas use karke complete marksheet create kar sake.
days.studentTask: 10 students ki marksheet formulas ke sath prepare karein.
days.homework: Week 8 revise karein.

days.title: Excel Charts Introduction
days.learningOutcome: Student data select karke basic charts create kar sake.
teacherGuide: Column aur Bar charts demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Student marks data se column aur bar chart create karein.
days.homework: Column aur Bar chart ka difference revise karein.

days.title: Line and Pie Charts
days.learningOutcome: Student different chart types create aur compare kar sake.
teacherGuide: Line aur Pie charts demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Same dataset se Line aur Pie chart create karein.
days.homework: Chart types revise karein.

days.title: Chart Formatting
days.learningOutcome: Student charts ko professional format aur layout de sake.
days.studentTask: Existing chart ko professional presentation ke liye format karein.
days.homework: Chart formatting options revise karein.

days.title: Sorting and Filtering Data
days.learningOutcome: Student Excel data ko sort aur filter kar sake.
days.studentTask: Student records ko name aur marks ke according sort aur filter karein.
days.homework: Sort aur Filter ka difference revise karein.

days.title: Excel Page Setup and Printing
days.learningOutcome: Student Excel sheets ko print ke liye correctly prepare kar sake.
days.studentTask: Marksheet ko print-ready format mein prepare karein.
days.homework: Excel printing options revise karein.

days.title: Expense Management Project
days.learningOutcome: Student Excel mein expense sheet, calculations aur chart create kar sake.
days.studentTask: Monthly expense sheet formulas aur chart ke sath prepare karein.
days.homework: Week 9 revise karein.

days.title: Google Chrome Introduction
days.learningOutcome: Student Chrome browser ke basic controls use kar sake.
days.studentTask: Chrome mein 5 websites open karke tabs manage karein.
days.homework: Chrome basic controls revise karein.

days.title: Google Search
days.learningOutcome: Student effective Google searches perform kar sake.
days.studentTask: 5 different topics par Google searches perform karein.
days.homework: Effective search keywords revise karein.

days.title: Images, Videos and Maps
days.learningOutcome: Student Google Images, Videos aur Maps basic level par use kar sake.
teacherGuide: Images, Videos aur Maps demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Ek image, ek educational video aur ek location Google par find karein.
days.homework: Google Images, Videos aur Maps revise karein.

days.title: Downloads and Bookmarks
days.learningOutcome: Student Chrome se files download aur bookmarks manage kar sake.
teacherGuide: Safe download aur bookmark workflow demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Ek safe educational file download aur ek useful website bookmark karein.
days.homework: Downloads aur Bookmarks revise karein.

days.title: History, Tabs and Incognito
days.learningOutcome: Student browser history, tabs aur basic privacy mode samajh sake.
teacherGuide: History aur Incognito ka purpose explain karein
days.studentTask: Multiple tabs manage karein aur Incognito mode observe karein.
days.homework: History aur Incognito ke uses revise karein.

days.title: Internet Practical Test
days.learningOutcome: Student basic Internet browsing tasks independently perform kare.
days.studentTask: Complete Chrome practical test independently perform karein.
days.homework: Week 10 revise karein.

days.title: Email Introduction and Gmail
days.learningOutcome: Student email aur Gmail ke basic concepts samajh kar inbox use kar sake.
days.studentTask: Gmail inbox open karke main sections identify karein.
days.homework: Email aur Gmail ki definitions revise karein.

days.title: Sending Email
days.learningOutcome: Student correctly formatted email compose aur send kar sake.
days.studentTask: Teacher ko simple professional email compose aur send karein.
days.homework: Email ke To, Subject aur Message fields revise karein.

days.title: Reply, Forward and Email Management
days.learningOutcome: Student emails ko reply, forward, archive aur delete kar sake.
teacherGuide: Reply, Reply All aur Forward ka difference explain karein
days.studentTask: Received email ko reply aur forward karke practice karein.
days.homework: Reply, Reply All aur Forward revise karein.

days.title: Email Attachments
days.learningOutcome: Student email ke sath files aur images attach aur download kar sake.
teacherGuide: Unknown attachments ke risks explain karein
days.studentTask: Ek document attach karke practice email send karein.
days.homework: Email attachments ke safety rules revise karein.

days.title: Email Management
days.learningOutcome: Student Gmail inbox ko organize aur search kar sake.
days.studentTask: Inbox mein emails search aur organize karein.
days.homework: Gmail folders aur labels revise karein.

days.title: Internet Safety and Phishing
days.learningOutcome: Student common online scams, phishing aur unsafe downloads identify kar sake.
practical: Personal information protection rules learn karna
days.studentTask: Given examples mein safe aur unsafe online activities identify karein.
days.homework: 10 Internet safety rules revise karein.

days.title: Windows and File Management Revision
days.learningOutcome: Student complete file organization workflow independently perform kare.
teacherGuide: Complete file management workflow revise karein
days.studentTask: Apne naam ke folder mein complete organized structure prepare karein.
days.homework: Windows aur file management revise karein.

days.title: Word Final Project - Academy Admission Form
days.learningOutcome: Student professional admission form Word mein create kar sake.
teacherGuide: Students ke final documents check karein
days.studentTask: Mustafa Digital Academy ka professional admission form create karein.
days.homework: Word final project revise karein.

days.title: Excel Final Project - Student Result Management
days.learningOutcome: Student formulas, formatting, sorting aur charts use karke complete result management sheet bana sake.
teacherGuide: Complete result management project demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Student Result Management workbook complete formulas aur chart ke sath prepare karein.
days.homework: Excel final project revise karein.

days.title: Chrome and Email Final Practical
days.learningOutcome: Student browser aur email ke complete practical workflow independently perform kare.
teacherGuide: Complete Chrome and Email practical workflow demonstrate karein
days.studentTask: Complete Internet and Email final practical independently perform karein.
days.homework: Final exam ke liye Week 1-11 revise karein.

days.title: Mock Practical Examination
days.learningOutcome: Student final practical examination ke format mein complete tasks perform kare.
teacherGuide: 100 marks mock practical exam conduct karein
days.studentTask: 100 marks mock practical examination independently complete karein.
days.homework: Weak areas revise karein.

days.title: Final Practical Examination and Course Completion
days.learningOutcome: Student complete 72-day computer course ki practical skills demonstrate karke final assessment complete kare.
teacherGuide: Student ke complete practical skills evaluate karein
Successful students ko course completion status dein
days.studentTask: Final practical examination complete karein aur assigned tasks independently perform karein.
days.homework: Course complete hone ke baad learned computer skills ki regular practice continue karein.
